notes: Mandatory caveat for any citation of R1 `data-confirmed` (R11 audit F1): the 0.5 null is not a random-walk baseline. A drift-matched random walk run through the same machinery gives p_extend of about 0.65 to 0.69 (auditor: iid 0.654, zero drift 0.633, block bootstrap 0.695, with P(>= 0.8788) of about 0.0005, 0.0005 and 0.0085). The harness random-walk p is p_sim = 0.0055. Cite the baseline 0.65 to 0.69, p_sim and n = 33; never p_holm alone.
